description.value: Zougla is a family-run restaurant in Nanaimo that has been part of the Vassilopoulos family's hospitality legacy since 1996, alongside The Bold Knight (open since 1977). The menu spans Mediterranean cuisine, steaks, seafood, and Asian-inspired dishes, served in a sit-down dining room setting. Its location just minutes from the Departure Bay Ferry Terminal makes it a plausible stop for cyclists arriving or departing by BC Ferries.
